title: Reuse the EN VIVO vocabulary
description: Instead of introducing the word 'estimado', trail the countdown with a small green '· en vivo' tag (dot + text), echoing the EN VIVO mode badge already on the board. Ties the row's provenance to language the rider has already parsed, rather than a second term. Schedule-only rows carry no tag.
baseline_ref: app/components/ArrivalRow.vue: estimated rows use the 'estimado' pill; ModeBadge/status uses green 'EN VIVO' (--color-ok)

changes.intent: Append a compact live tag after the number for estimated rows and remove the separate pill/prefix.
changes.detail: Remove the .arrival-row__badge--estimated pill and the .arrival-row__scheduled prefix. When arrival.estimated && etaMinutes > 0, append inside .arrival-row__eta a en vivo after the unit.

changes.intent: Small green trailing tag matching the EN VIVO token, subordinate to the countdown.
Reuse the pulsing live dot language from .arrival-row__badge-dot.
